Title: Lead Data/Analytics Engineer
Description:
About Us

Dutch is transforming veterinary care by making expert treatment accessible anytime, anywhere. Our mission is simple: help every pet live their happiest, healthiest life by connecting pet parents with licensed vets through seamless virtual visits.

We’re the only veterinary telemedicine service that can diagnose, prescribe, and ship medications directly to customers in most states. For less than $100 per year, Dutch offers real relief and convenience for pets and their families.

Backed by world-class investors including Forerunner Ventures, Eclipse Ventures, and Bling Capital, our team is made up of successful startup founders (Hims, PlushCare, Nasty Gal) with expertise in scaling enterprises (TripAdvisor, Walmart, BARK). Featured in TechCrunch, Forbes, Wired, and Axios, Dutch is setting the standard for quality, accessibility, and compassion in pet care.

The Role

We’re looking for a Lead Data/Analytics Engineer to own how Dutch measures its product and business. You’ll run the event instrumentation pipeline, build the models and metrics layers that teams use to make decisions, and sit shoulder-to-shoulder with product managers to design and analyze experiments. When data engineering work needs doing, you can pick it up without missing a beat.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You’ll work across our modern data stack: Segment and Amplitude for behavioral data, Snowflake and dbt for warehousing and modeling, Prefect for orchestration, and Sigma for BI. You’ll partner with the BI team (which governs all data model builds) and with product engineering to make sure every dashboard, metric, and experiment runs on data the company trusts.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Product Analytics & Experimentation (40%)

Own the event pipeline from instrumentation through Segment into Amplitude, Iterable, and Snowflake, including sources, destinations, and reverse ETL
Define and publish a typed event schema and governance workflow that frontend teams build against, so event data stays consistent across web and mobile
Design and validate tracking plans for new features and surfaces, and confirm events flow end to end before launch
Partner with product managers to design experiments in Amplitude: define hypotheses, select metrics, set guardrails, and size tests
Build Amplitude charts, funnels, cohorts, and dashboards that help product teams answer their own questions without waiting on you
Debug identity resolution, user properties, and experiment assignment issues across Segment, Amplitude, and downstream tools
Analyze experiment results and present findings to stakeholders with clear recommendations

Data Engineering & Infrastructure (35%)

Build, maintain, and optimize ELT pipelines using dbt, Prefect and Fivetran
Own core datasets and dbt models in Snowflake in partnership with the BI and product engineering teams
Lead infrastructure modernization: orchestration and dbt version upgrades, flow runtime reduction, Snowflake compute and storage cost optimization
Drive warehouse security and governance work, including access controls, remediation of security assessment findings, and PII handling
Implement data quality tests, freshness checks, observability, and alerting across critical pipelines
Troubleshoot pipeline failures and data incidents, and drive root-cause fixes rather than patches

Metrics, Semantic Layer & AI Data Products (25%)

Deliver ready-to-consume data marts that power product features such as recommendations and personalization, plus the baselines to measure them
Contribute to the semantic layer that gives BI tools and AI features a single source of truth for metric definitions
Supply reliable, well-governed data to AI features that improve the member experience and vet workflows
Define and document the company’s core metrics so every team calculates things the same way

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

6+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or hybrid data roles
Strong proficiency in SQL and Python
Deep hands-on experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse
Production experience with dbt, including testing, documentation, and CI
Experience with product analytics platforms, ideally Amplitude, including funnels, cohorts, experiment configuration, and identity resolution
Experience with customer data platforms and event pipelines, ideally Segment, including tracking plan design, destination management, and debugging
Demonstrated experience designing and analyzing A/B tests or product experiments
Experience with orchestration tools such as Prefect, Airflow, or Dagster
Comfortable with Git-based workflows and CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions
Uses AI tools (code assistants, LLMs, etc.) as part of daily work and can show how
Familiarity with BI tools like Sigma, Looker, or Tableau
Bonus: experience with semantic layers, data contracts, ML/LLM applications in production, or cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

WHY YOU'RE A GREAT FIT:

You treat trust in the numbers as the product. When a metric is wrong, you feel it personally
You can build an event taxonomy from scratch and also explain to a PM why their experiment needs a bigger sample size
You’re as comfortable writing dbt models as you are reviewing an experiment readout with a product lead
You use AI tools every day to move faster and expect to keep pushing that boundary
You’re self-directed and comfortable managing your own priorities in a fast-moving environment
You care about data quality, reproducibility, and documentation because you’ve been burned by their absence
You love animals

WHY WORK FOR DUTCH?

Competitive salary range between $185K - $220K CAD
Hybrid working location
Health, Dental and Vision Insurance
Life and Disability Insurance
Flexible PTO
Mental Wellbeing Options
Robust Holiday Schedule
Registered Retirement Savings Plan
Growth Opportunities!

DUTCH'S GUIDING PRINCIPLES

Pets First – business and medical decisions are always guided by the pet’s best interest. We’ll never compromise on pet health and we’re all here because we care about their well-being
Agile Like a Cat – We have a bias toward swift action, while maintaining quality and accuracy. For us, that means being able to turn on a dime, like a cat, analyze our options – even ones that may not be on the table – then execute without perfection getting in the way
Creativity is our Catnip – Creativity feeds us and helps us push boundaries to always find better solutions, making the complex more accessible and easier to understand
Be the Human Your Dog Thinks You Are – Be kind, show care for your colleagues, and even if you’re an expert - give others context, reinforce the positive, and help them understand.

Title: AI Solutions Architect
Description:
About KLONDIKE

For over 35 years, KLONDIKE Lubricants has challenged the status quo to become one of Canada’s leading independent manufacturers and marketers of high-performance commercial, industrial, and automotive lubricants, greases, and specialty chemicals.




KLONDIKE manages a portfolio of more than 650 SKUs and sells exclusively through a distributor network of over 700 independent distributors across Canada and the United States. These distributors, in turn, serve a wide range of end markets including automotive, heavy-duty on-road and off-road, mining, forestry, agriculture, and industrial applications.




KLONDIKE does not sell directly to end users or mass merchandisers. This disciplined approach has allowed the company to build long-term, trust-based partnerships and consistently deliver profitable growth.




Building on its strong Canadian foundation, KLONDIKE is also in the early stages of expanding its presence in the United States. This growth is intentional and disciplined, following the same distributor-focused model that has driven success in Canada, and represents an important next chapter in the company’s long-term growth strategy.




KLONDIKE’s business model is built around one simple guiding principle: We Grow Independent Business.




This philosophy shapes how the company designs products, sets pricing, manages inventory, delivers service, and partners with distributors. KLONDIKE is positioned just below the global majors on price, while meeting or exceeding required industry specifications and certifications. The company competes on value, trust, availability, and technical credibility — not on being the cheapest option in the market.




Manufacturing and warehousing are fully outsourced to long-term strategic partners, while KLONDIKE invests heavily in inventory across six warehouses. Supply chain reliability and product availability are core competitive advantages and key drivers of distributor loyalty.

www.klondikelubricants.com




Investors

KLONDIKE Lubricants is backed by Snowdon Partners, a private equity firm focused on helping companies grow and reach their full potential.

www.snowdonpartners.ca




The Role

KLONDIKE Lubricants is seeking a high-caliber AI Solutions Architect to turn defined business opportunities into working AI-enabled solutions. This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who can bridge business process, software integration, automation, applied AI, and who measures success by what is actually deployed and used.




KLONDIKE is building a role-based AI operating model across Sales, Technical, Client Care, Supply Chain, Marketing, and Finance. The strategy is to create defined digital roles that follow KLONDIKE processes, use approved systems and data, and operate within clear governance and authority limits.




Working directly with the CEO and functional leaders, the role turns clearly scoped problems into technical solutions, from agents to production-ready processes. The successful candidate owns the hardening work required to make AI dependable for day-to-day operations. The role will also help KLONDIKE build toward a future orchestration layer that coordinates the broader agent network, manages information flow, source consistency, monitors quality, and provides visibility into agent performance and exceptions.




Who You Are

You are a practical builder who is comfortable moving between a business process discussion and the technical implementation required to make it work. You can understand a functional leader’s objectives, identify gaps in the process or specifications, and translate them into solutions that are simple to use and robust enough to trust. You expect APIs to fail, permissions to change, source data to be imperfect, and model behavior to vary. You design for those realities with validation, retries, exception paths, logging, quality checks, and human approval where required.




You work with urgency without sacrificing reliability, prototype quickly, and understand the difference between a demo and a production workflow. You take ownership of the last 20%: testing, documentation, error handling, deployment, support, and iteration. You stay current as AI platforms change without chasing every new tool. You select the best fit while protecting KLONDIKE's data, process integrity, and systems of record.




Key Responsibilities

Solution Design & Build

Translate scoped business opportunities into technical designs, build plans, and working pilots.
Build AI agents, workflow automations, internal tools, and system-assisted processes that solve defined operating problems.
Select the simplest architecture that can deliver the required business outcome without creating unnecessary technical complexity.
Rapidly prototype concepts, then harden successful pilots for dependable day-to-day use.
Challenge incomplete or weak specifications and work with business owners to resolve process gaps before automating them.

Systems, Data & Integration

Integrate AI workflows with approved systems and data, including SAP Business One, HubSpot, Power BI, Valogix, SharePoint, Outlook, and core commercial and product data.
Build and maintain API-based integrations, authentication flows, connectors, data transformations, and system handoffs.
Preserve source-of-truth rules and stable identifiers, including BP Code where commercial and CRM data are connected.
Design solutions so data access, confidentiality, permissions, and write-back authority match the intended business role.
Create reusable integration patterns so successful solutions can be extended across functions rather than rebuilt from scratch.

Testing, Quality & Reliability

Own functional testing, edge-case testing, regression testing, and business-user acceptance testing before rollout.
Build validation and quality checks for model outputs, data transformations, document generation, and system write-backs.
Design for failure with retries, idempotency, timeout handling, exception routing, audit trails, and clear recovery paths.
Implement practical monitoring and observability so failures can be detected, understood, and corrected quickly.
Establish repeatable evaluation standards so AI performance is measured rather than assumed.

Deployment, Adoption & Continuous Improvement

Deploy solutions in controlled stages with clear ownership, user instructions, approval requirements, and escalation paths.
Work directly with business users during pilots to capture friction, identify failure modes, and improve the workflow before wider rollout.
Document architecture, source rules, permissions, known limitations, operating procedures, and support requirements.
Monitor adoption and business impact after launch and prioritize improvements based on reliability and value delivered.
Maintain working solutions as underlying AI models, platforms, connectors, and business processes change.

Platform, Vendor & Technical Ownership

Evaluate AI platforms, agent frameworks, automation tools, and integration approaches based on business fit, reliability, security, and total cost.
Use specialist consultants selectively where they accelerate delivery or provide expertise not required full-time, while retaining internal ownership of the solution architecture and operating knowledge.
Manage technical vendors and consultants to defined scopes, deliverables, quality standards, and timelines.
Reduce dependence on any single AI interface or vendor by designing portable processes and preserving KLONDIKE-owned instructions, data definitions, and documentation.

Future Agent Orchestration

Help design the future AI orchestration layer that coordinates work across KLONDIKE's network of functional AI roles.
Create common patterns for workflow routing, information synchronization, agent-to-agent handoffs, quality assurance, monitoring, and exception management.
Support consistent source rules and version control across the agent network so different roles operate from the same approved information.
Build toward a scalable AgentOps capability with visibility into usage, performance, quality, cost, failures, and change history.




Your Profile

5+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, solutions engineering, automation, systems integration, or a related hands-on technical role.
Experience building and deploying real-world AI/LLM workflows using modern LLM platforms and agent/orchestration tools; able to evaluate and build across platforms.
Strong working capability with Python, REST APIs, JSON, SQL/data manipulation, authentication concepts, and workflow automation.
Experience integrating ERP, CRM, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, and email platforms.
Strong understanding of production reliability: testing, logging, monitoring, exception handling, permissions, data validation, and secure system write-back.
Ability to map a business process, from identifying failure points and exceptions to translating into practical technical workflow.
Strong judgment about when AI should recommend, prepare, request approval, or take action /not take action.
Comfortable working independently from clear objectives with minimal overhead.
Strong written and verbal communication; able to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical leaders and users.
Experience with SAP Business One, HubSpot, Microsoft Graph, Power Platform, Azure, OpenAI/Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, or comparable platforms is an asset.
Experience in distribution, manufacturing, industrial products, or inventory-intensive environments is a plus.
A computer science or engineering degree is a plus.




What We Offer

An opportunity to build applied AI capability inside an established, profitable business with meaningful real-world use cases across every major function.
A high-performance environment where decision velocity, ownership, continuous improvement, and results matter.
Brand new, open-concept space in Langley, with modern design and the latest communication technology.
A collaborative work model with Monday-Thursday in office, Friday as a flex day.
Medical benefits, parking, laptop, smart phone.

Description:
About Us:

With over 60 years of industry experience, Gescan has 29 branches located across Western Canada. At Gescan, we leverage our strong global resource base, our local expertise, and our family-oriented values to deliver the best service to our customers and suppliers.

We are a proud member of the Sonepar Group, the world's largest privately-held electrical distributor. The Sonepar Group is present in more than 40 countries with over 45,000 employees. In Canada, we are represented by 6 locally managed electrical and industrial distributors and have over 110 locations with coverage in 9 provinces.

To explore and learn more about Sonepar opportunities, please visit www.career.sonepar.com




What’s In It For You?

You will be joining a market leader with over 40 years of experience to help you elevate your potential.
You will be working for the world's #1 privately held business to business distributor of electrical products and related solutions.
A chance to get involved in the forever growing electrical industry.
We house the largest inventory to better service our customers and deliver on sales commitments.
An opportunity for career development across many business departments within our organization.




Scope

Under the supervision of the Pricing Manager, the primary mandate of the Pricing Analyst is to analyze any trend, from products, categories, customers and suppliers. The analyst will be responsible for the creation, structure and management of the product database.




Responsibilities

Tool development
Develop dynamic pricing tools and models to effectively meet business needs.
Extract, process, and edit reports from Cognos and Power BI (Excel file, Access, pivot tables).
Perform complex analyses of our current pricing, product, vendor customer data using Excel, Power BI, Cognos, and our internal and external databases.
Analyze and interpret market trends in collaboration with internal teams for the purpose of developing competitive pricing strategies;
Analyze data from a variety of sources to better understand pricing strategies, better structure our customer types, and better aggregate our products and suppliers.
Prepare and present the results of the pricing and profitability analysis to management.
Keep abreast of different methods of price analysis, industry trends, and database management
Develop dynamic tools to improve database management.
Participate in the management of the information of the database and ensure the compliance of the information found therein and propose solutions.Team Support
Validate and approve pricing agreements on a daily basis to understand the pricing cycle and support the team as needed.
Assist the team in preparing for IT changes on products, categories, customers and suppliers.
All other related tasks.




Required

Bachelor's degree in administration or related field.
Excellent command of Microsoft Office suite tools (Excel, Access, Outlook, Teams).
Good knowledge of technological tools such as MS VBA/SQL, Python, Power BI, Power Apps.
Knowledge of Cognos (an asset). • A minimum of 1-3 years of experience in the field and/or related field.
Experience in interpretation, data analysis, database management, and dashboard creation.
Programming experience (basic).




Benefits & Perks

We offer a competitive salary, plus a full set of benefits.

Benefits program allowing you to choose from options that best fit you and your dependents’ needs. Benefit options include: Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Spending Account & RRSP matching.
Employee Assistance Program, Tuition Reimbursement, Employee Discounts and a career path.
Regardless of your benefits program, you will receive company paid Life Insurance, and employee paid disability.

Title: Process & Data Mapping Associate
Description:
About Wesgar
Wesgar is a leader in the custom sheet metal fabrication industry, specializing in high-mix, low-volume manufacturing for a wide range of global sectors. Based in Port Coquitlam, we pride ourselves on a workplace culture built on empathy, professional development, and operational excellence. We are committed to maintaining a professional, inclusive, and high-energy environment where every team member has the opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects.

Position Summary
Wesgar is seeking an early-career Process & Data Mapping Associate to support continuous improvement across our production and warehouse operations.

The primary focus of this role is analyzing and interpreting manufacturing data to identify trends, bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and opportunities for process improvement. You will work with large operational datasets, production KPIs, and information from multiple systems to understand what is happening on the shop floor and translate findings into practical recommendations.

The role also includes direct observation of production processes, working with operators and supervisors to validate findings, and documenting current and improved workflows. This is a hands-on position that combines data analysis with a practical understanding of manufacturing operations.

Key Responsibilities

Production Data Analysis & Reporting
Collect, organize, clean, and analyze production and operational data from multiple sources
Analyze manufacturing data to identify trends, bottlenecks, downtime, process variation, recurring issues, and improvement opportunities
Work with large datasets and validate data accuracy, completeness, and consistency before drawing conclusions
Develop and maintain Excel reports, dashboards, trackers, and analytical tools to support operational decision-making
Compare production performance across processes, equipment, products, shifts, or time periods to identify meaningful patterns
Translate data findings into clear conclusions and practical recommendations for production and operational teams
Establish and monitor relevant KPIs to measure process performance and the impact of implemented improvements
Present analytical findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Process Improvement & Operational Analysis
Work directly with production teams to understand the operational context behind the data and validate analytical findings
Observe production and warehouse processes firsthand to understand workflows, material movement, equipment use, and operator practices
Investigate production issues using data, direct observation, and input from operators and supervisors
Support root cause analysis and corrective actions related to productivity, quality, workflow, and other operational issues
Develop and evaluate practical process-improvement options based on quantitative and observational findings
Support pilot activities, implementation, and follow-up to determine whether improvements are achieving the expected results
Process Mapping & Documentation
Document current-state workflows and key process steps based on production-floor observation and stakeholder input
Create and update process maps, flowcharts, SOPs, work instructions, and other process documentation
Help develop improved future-state workflows where process changes are required
Work with operators, supervisors, and process owners to ensure documentation accurately reflects how work is performed
Support the transition of successful process improvements into clear and sustainable standard work


Requirements

1–3 years of relevant experience working with manufacturing, production, operational, or industrial data. Relevant co-op or internship experience may be considered
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Data Analytics, Statistics, Business Analytics, Engineering Technology, or a related discipline. Other educational backgrounds may be considered with directly relevant manufacturing or production data-analysis experience
Demonstrated experience analyzing production or manufacturing datasets to identify trends, issues, bottlenecks, or process-improvement opportunities
Strong Microsoft Excel skills and confidence organizing, manipulating, validating, and interpreting large datasets
Ability to move beyond reporting and dashboards to draw meaningful conclusions from data and recommend practical operational improvements
Previous experience in a manufacturing, production, warehouse, or other industrial environment is strongly preferred
Comfortable working directly with production teams and spending time on the shop floor to understand and validate what the data is showing
Previous experience with process improvement, root cause analysis, workflow analysis, or continuous improvement projects
Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to operators, supervisors, and other stakeholders
Strong attention to data accuracy and experience handling confidential or sensitive business information appropriately
A valid driver’s licence and reliable vehicle are required for travel between our Port Coquitlam and Pitt Meadows locations

Preferred Qualifications
Experience with Power BI, Python, SQL, or similar data-analysis and visualization tools
Experience working with ERP or manufacturing systems
Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing, Value Stream Mapping, 5 Why, Pareto analysis, or other continuous-improvement tools
Experience creating process maps, workflow diagrams, SOPs, or standardized work documentation

Schedule & Pay Details
Location: Port Coquitlam, BC | Pitt Meadows, BC
Pay: $26.00 – $30.00 per hour
Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Why Join Us?
Equal Opportunity: Wesgar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
Mentorship: Receive direct mentorship from experienced manufacturing leaders.
Real-World Impact: Gain hands-on experience in a real-world production environment with exposure to diverse operational projects.

Apply today to help us drive operational excellence at Wesgar!

Keywords: Industrial engineering, Manufacturing engineering, Process improvement, Operational excellence, Production data analysis.
